promptVersions.body:
Mogli defines a Gateway as an outbound phone number. Gateways are the phone numbers you'll be using to send/receive texts. By selecting the All list view, you'll be able to see all of the Gateways we've configured to date in your org.


By selecting a particular Gateway name, you'll have access to edit the name of your Gateway. Depending on how your Gateways are parsed amongst your users, a Gateway Name may be the name of a person, department, or business vertical. The Gateway Name is what will appear in the drop-down menus in Conversation View and in Bulk SMS.


IMPORTANT: Please refrain from modifying any Gateway-related fields other than Gateway Name. Doing so will impact connectivity to our messaging partner.
promptVersions.description: About how we define a Gateway, changing the Gateway Name, and fields to leave as-is.
promptVersions.title: Your Outbound Phone Numbers
